title: Teamwork in TCG raid boss
author: No-Possibility1721
selftext:
I would appreciate your professional perspective on implementing a community-driven raid boss mechanic within a TCG pack-opening simulator.

I have developed a website centered around TCG pack openings that features an integrated economy. In this system, users collaborate to reduce the health of raid bosses through pack openings and site engagement. Do you believe this mechanic is effectively suited for a TCG simulator environment?

The core functionality is already operational and can be reviewed here

https://cardpackhunter.com/c/reddit-campaign
